description: Skyway Air support documentation and staff discussion about ticket categories.

files.description: A Confluence page in the support-playbooks space for support agents about ticket categories, last updated between 2026-01-12 and 2026-05-15. It must contain these sentences word for word: "the categories are refund, disruption, baggage, change, service and other"; "baggage is for delayed, damaged or missing bags and bag claims"; "change is for changing a booking"; "other is for anything else, such as general questions, injuries and equipment"; "refund is for trips the customer did not take"; "disruption is for trips they travelled through"; "refunds of extras they could not use are service"; "if a trip refund is part of it, use refund". Do not state any other policy amount, limit, deadline or rule. Any example situation must fit these sentences: do not show anyone giving, arranging or refusing a hotel, meal, voucher, credit, refund or compensation beyond what they say, and do not set an example in a weather, air traffic control or airport security disruption unless they mention it. Do not mention battery, batteries, lithium, power bank, watt-hour.
